title: The CFTC uses its "emergency authority" to order Kalshi to continue operating in New York after the state filed a lawsuit in July seeking to shutter Kalshi (Nikhilesh De/CoinDesk)
summary: Nikhilesh De / CoinDesk: The CFTC uses its “emergency authority” to order Kalshi to continue operating in New York after the state filed a lawsuit in July seeking to shutter Kalshi — The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced it had ordered prediction market operator Kalshi to continue operating …
contentText:
Nikhilesh De / CoinDesk :

The US CFTC uses its “emergency authority” to order Kalshi to continue operating in New York after the state filed a lawsuit in July seeking to shutter Kalshi   —  The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced it had ordered prediction market operator Kalshi to continue operating …
